description: Header file defining the CachingCertVerifier class, which caches certificate verification results to optimize performance in the Chromium project.

classes.name: CachingCertVerifier
classes.description: A class that caches certificate verification results to improve efficiency, implementing CertVerifier and observer interfaces.

methods.name: Verify
methods.description: Performs certificate verification, using cache if available.

methods.name: SetConfig
methods.description: Sets configuration parameters for the verifier.

methods.name: AddObserver
methods.description: Adds an observer for verifier events.

methods.name: OnRequestFinished
methods.description: Handles completion of a verification request, caching the result.

methods.name: OnCertVerifierChanged
methods.description: Handles changes in the cert verifier.

methods.name: OnCertDBChanged
methods.description: Handles changes in the certificate database.
